Taylor: Hey @people-ops — quick q. I'm scheduled for a rotating late-night support rotation starting next week and the lactation room is locked after hours. How do I get access during my overnight shifts? I need approx 2 breaks/night. Thanks!

Jordan (manager): Thanks for flagging Taylor. Can People Ops help with temporary access or shift swaps?

Casey (People Ops): Hi @Taylor @Jordan — we can help. Quick Qs: do you have an existing accommodation on file? If not, we can initiate a short-term accommodation. Please fill the form here: https://redwood.company/hr/accommodation (choose "lactation/private spaces"). We'll also coordinate a temporary badge override and optional shift coverage.

Taylor: I don't have anything on file yet. Filling now.

Casey (People Ops): Great. Once submitted, we can approve an interim access within 24-48h. Options: 1) temporary badge override (Facilities), 2) formal shift coverage (team covers 15–30min pump breaks), 3) designate a second lactation room in building B. Which would you prefer?

Riley (Facilities): Can confirm badge override is doable. Need building, floor, and exact 2-hour windows. We can set up a schedule access rule `lactation_override_Taylor` valid for 30 days. Please DM with building/floor. cc: @facilities-bot (#ticket 3421)

facilities-bot: New ticket created: #FAC-3421 — "Lactation room badge override for Taylor" — ETA 36h

Jordan (manager): Team is fine covering. Taylor, if you prefer coverage over badge, we can rotate swaps. What times do you expect to pump?

Taylor: Usually between 1:00–1:15am and 3:30–3:45am during shift. Badge override would be easiest.

Casey (People Ops): Noted. Please attach those times in the accommodation form. We'll mark this as medical accommodation per policy and expedite. Also FYI lactation rooms are for pumping only; please follow posted guidelines.

Marisol (People Ops): Adding: If overnight access may create safety concerns, Facilities will pair with security to escort if needed. Also we can offer paid temporary shift swaps if needed — reach out to payroll for eligibility.

Taylor: Thanks everyone! Filled form and DM'd Riley building/floor. Appreciate the quick turnaround :grin: 

Riley (Facilities): Got the DM, set badge override to active in 34h. Will update ticket.

Casey (People Ops): Closing loop — Taylor, expect email confirmation and a stub accommodation note in HR portal. If you want confidentiality, we can keep details restricted to People Ops + Manager + Facilities. Let us know.

Taylor: Confirmed, confidentiality appreciated. Thanks again :heart:
